purpose: Teach: 洋子/四郎/敦/小僧/無題/赤色/紗子/和子

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お母様のお友達の洋子さんが今度遊びにいらっしゃるわ
lines.en: Sho, your father's friend Yoko is coming to visit us soon.
lines.style: Warm, matter-of-fact delivery. Soft opening. Speaking as though sharing pleasant news with him — inclusive, never condescending. Light and easy rhythm.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんの古いお友達の四郎おじさんと会ったよ
lines.en: Mom, I met Shiro-ojisan today — Dad's old friend.
lines.style: Bright, straightforward. Quick tempo. Child's unfiltered excitement — he's just reporting a fact that delighted him. No affectation, genuine pleasure in the telling.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが「敦くんは元気そうね」って仰ってたわ
lines.en: Sho, your father was saying Atsushi seems really energetic these days.
lines.style: Gentle, conversational. Thoughtful pause before the observation. Warm recollection — she's relaying something her husband noticed. Unhurried, like she's thinking aloud to Sho.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんに「やんちゃな小僧だな」って笑われたよ
lines.en: Mom, Dad laughed and called me a rascal — a mischievous little troublemaker.
lines.style: Small, genuine laugh threaded through. Child's wry self-awareness — he knows what 'yancha' means and is amused by it. Slight proud tilt to his voice, quick and light.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが「絵に無題と書くのもいい」って仰ってたわ
lines.en: Sho, your father was saying it's nice to paint without a title too.
lines.style: Soft, thoughtful delivery. Pause before the compliment — she's relaying something she found meaningful. Gentle approval in her tone, like she's passing on his wisdom to Sho.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんと赤色の絵の具で絵を描いたよ
lines.en: Mom, today Dad and I painted a picture together with red paint.
lines.style: Eager, slightly proud. Quick bright pace. Child radiating the warmth of having done something together with his father. Simple joy — he's sharing the memory, not seeking approval.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが「お友達の紗子ちゃんによろしくね」って仰ってたわ
lines.en: Sho, your father was saying to say hello to Sako for him.
lines.style: Gentle, relay-like cadence. Warm tone — she's passing on a message that includes Sho in his father's thinking. Unhurried, affectionate in its simplicity.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、お父さんが「和子おばさんから果物を頂いた」って仰ってたよ
lines.en: Mom, Dad said Aunt Kazuko gave him some fruit.
lines.style: Eager, bright closing. Quick warm tempo. Child eager to share another small detail from his day — the rhythm picks up slightly as he finishes. Genuine, unguarded excitement.
